summary: Foremost Clean Energy Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on August 28, 2026, attaching a press release announcing an early warning report regarding its passive stake in Rio Grande Resources Ltd. The filing reports that due to a non-participated private placement by Rio Grande, Foremost's ownership fell from 11.01% to 8.65%, crossing below the 10% early warning threshold. No transaction was initiated by Foremost; the change was purely dilutionary. The filing is regulatory disclosure under Canadian rules, not a special-situation event. No deal terms, valuation, or strategic actions are involved.
